exclusions: Diagnosis, classification, targets and treatment choice.
Any drug, dose or amount of anything given.
intent.population: People recorded as having diabetes, chronic kidney disease, or both. No narrower scope is assumed.
intent.purpose: Compose the diabetes and kidney documentation elements so that both can be described together, while each shared or similar field keeps its own meaning.
intent.rationale: The kidney element is optional so that a missing kidney context is reported as indeterminate, never as false or normal.
intent.setting: Any care setting that follows people with both conditions. Narrowing is for the local clinician to declare.

manifest.name: Diabetes and chronic kidney disease: element group

provenance.basis: None. No clinical source and no clinical review.
provenance.origin: Synthetic demonstration written for the second demo (row 4.5c.2).

sharedConcepts.meaning: Two different dates. One is when diabetes was recorded as diagnosed, the other when chronic kidney disease was. They share a key and are never one value.

Both only record that an arrangement is written down. One is a diabetes treatment plan, the other a kidney follow-up arrangement. They are different facts with different owners and are never combined.
